description: This file defines the 'Group' entity class for the Fineract project, representing a group or center with associated properties and behaviors, including hierarchy management, client and group membership, status transitions, and staff assignments.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Entity class representing a group or center with properties such as status, hierarchy, members, staff, and lifecycle methods for managing its state and relationships.

methods.name: newGroup
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Group instance with specified parameters, defaulting to pending or active status based on input.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Transitions the group to an active state and sets activation date, optionally reassigning staff if it's a center.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the group, setting closure reason, date, and changing status to closed.

methods.name: associateClients
methods.description: Associates a set of clients with the group, throwing exception if any are already members.

methods.name: disassociateClients
methods.description: Removes clients from group membership, throwing exception if a client is not part of the group.

methods.name: generateHierarchy
methods.description: Builds the hierarchical path string based on parent groups.

methods.name: resetHierarchy
methods.description: Resets the hierarchy string to a default based on group ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates group attributes based on provided JsonCommand, tracking changed fields.

methods.name: associateGroups
methods.description: Associates other groups as members, with validations to prevent invalid memberships.

methods.name: disassociateGroups
methods.description: Removes group memberships, resetting hierarchy accordingly.

methods.name: isGroupsClientCountWithinMinMaxRange
methods.description: Checks if active client count falls within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: isGroupsClientCountWithinMaxRange
methods.description: Checks if active client count is within maximum limit.

methods.name: getActiveClientMembers
methods.description: Returns set of active (not closed) client members.

methods.name: captureStaffHistoryDuringCenterCreation
methods.description: Records staff assignment history when creating an active center.

methods.name: reassignStaff
methods.description: Reassigns staff to the group and logs the assignment history.

methods.name: removeStaff
methods.description: Unassigns staff and updates the staff assignment history.
